title: Read type-tagged JSON into a serde enum
summary: Replace a hand-written match over Value with an internally tagged enum using tag = "type".

turns.user: the event json from the frontend, stuff like {"type": "click", "x": 1, "y": 2}. im branching on Value by hand and all i get back is None, no idea what was wrong. can this be less bad

assistant.body: Sure! Adding #[serde(tag = "type")] makes it an internally tagged enum. serde picks the variant from the value of type and fills that variant from the remaining fields. rename_all = "snake_case" is what maps Click to click. A failure now comes back as an Error with a reason, like missing field `delta`, so the whole hand-written Option chain goes away.

turns.user: nice. oh forgot key_press also comes in. and if some unknown type shows up i want to ignore it, not error. the app keeps adding new ones

assistant.body: Note: to catch an unknown type, put #[serde(other)] on a unit variant with no fields. In an internally tagged enum, any extra fields that came with it are simply discarded. KeyPress becomes key_press under snake_case, so the name already matches.

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
#[serde(tag = "type", rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum Event {
    Click { x: i32, y: i32 },
    Scroll { delta: i32 },
    KeyPress { key: String },
    #[serde(other)]
    Unknown,
}
